name: Moonreef Sovereign Throne
introDiscord: At the Moonlit Reef’s farthest boundary, a royal reef rises where the Astral Tide and Lunar Current meet.
introTwitch: At the Moonlit Reef’s farthest boundary, a royal reef rises where the Astral Tide and Lunar Current meet.

sovereign-approach.name: Sovereign Approach
sovereign-approach.prompt: The sovereign approach crosses monumental coral toward three paths beneath a darkened crown.

left.message: Beyond Sovereign Approach, a restorative current shaped by Moonreef Sovereign Throne gathers in a quiet basin.
left.fullHpMessage: The restorative magic of Moonreef Sovereign Throne finds no wounds to mend. You are already at full HP.

right.message: Within Moonreef Sovereign Throne, the right path from Sovereign Approach reveals a hidden Moonkeeper cache.

forward.message: The water folds around Moonreef Sovereign, revealing the creature as it claims the passage.

crownreef-processional.name: Crownreef Processional
crownreef-processional.prompt: A processional of shattered Moonkeeper standards surrounds three routes through the royal reef.

left.message: The water folds around Moonreef Sovereign, revealing the creature as it claims the passage.

right.message: Beyond Crownreef Processional, a restorative current shaped by Moonreef Sovereign Throne gathers in a quiet basin.
right.fullHpMessage: The restorative magic of Moonreef Sovereign Throne finds no wounds to mend. You are already at full HP.

forward.message: Within Moonreef Sovereign Throne, the forward path from Crownreef Processional reveals a hidden moon-shell coffer.

last-moonkeeper-way.name: Last Moonkeeper Way
last-moonkeeper-way.prompt: The last way climbs through silent starlight, dividing before three gates to the throne.

left.message: Within Moonreef Sovereign Throne, the left path from Last Moonkeeper Way reveals a hidden Fae offering vessel.

right.message: The water folds around Moonreef Sovereign, revealing the creature as it claims the passage.

forward.message: A quiet recess beyond Last Moonkeeper Way preserves a dormant Fae shrine, but offers no material reward.

boss-antechamber.name: Throne of the First Tide
boss-antechamber.prompt: A powerful presence shifts beyond the final threshold while the surrounding reef falls still.

bossPromptDiscord:
You reach Throne of the First Tide. The water tightens around an unseen guardian whose presence fills the chamber.
Use /yes to continue or /no to retreat for now.
bossPromptTwitch: Throne of the First Tide: An unseen guardian stirs beyond the threshold. Use !yes to continue or !no to retreat.
bossRetreatText: You withdraw from Throne of the First Tide. The hidden guardian remains beyond the threshold.

boss.revealText: The chamber answers with a surge of reef magic. Crown of the Moonreef reveals itself!

completionText: The Crown of the Moonreef dissolves into a sweep of lunar radiance. Across the Moonlit Reef, old wards answer in sequence, marking every Adventure complete while the next region remains unchanged.
